build_class_index_mapping: build a class index mapping from source classes to target classes for remapping detection IDs
approximate_mask_with_polygons: approximate a binary segmentation mask with simplified polygons filtered by area
map_detections_class_id: map detection class IDs from a source index scheme to a target index scheme
train_test_split: split a list of data items into training and test sets with configurable ratio
merge_class_lists: merge multiple class lists into a single sorted list of unique class names
